title: MWBM-MEDIA-LANG reference data, version 1
description: Registry-derived data every implementation of the Media Language & BCP 47 Policy reads, so the Rust, PHP and Swift versions agree exactly on replacements and old three-letter codes. Generated by scripts/media-lang/generate_language_data.py — never edit by hand.
$comment: A registry refresh is a data_version bump. If it changes any answer in tests/fixtures/bcp47-language-policy-v1.json, the fixtures version must be bumped in the same change.

policy_version.description: Policy version the data was generated for.

sources.description: Exactly which downloads the data was built from.

retrieved.description: Date downloaded (the table has no date of its own).

sil_iso_639_3.description: The SIL ISO 639-3 code table (Part 2B / Part 2T / Part 1 columns).

special_languages.description: The four special-purpose codes (mul, mis, und, zxx) and what each means (LANG-003, LANG-025).

languages.description: Every registered primary language subtag, lower case, sorted. Ranges are listed separately.

language_ranges.description: Registered ranges of language subtags (qaa..qtz, local use).

extlangs.description: Each registered extlang subtag and the primary language(s) it may follow.

script_ranges.description: Registered ranges of script subtags (private use).

regions.description: Registered region subtags: two-letter codes upper case, three-digit UN M.49 codes.

region_ranges.description: Registered ranges of region subtags (private use).

preferred.description: Registry Preferred-Value replacements used by LANG-001 step 5, by subtag type.

extlang.description: Extlang -> the language that replaces language+extlang (yue -> yue).

deprecated_without_replacement.description: Deprecated subtags with no single replacement (for example CS, which split into two countries). Kept as written and reported, never guessed (LANG-001).

tag.description: The tag as the registry spells it (its canonical case).

preferred.description: Replacement, or null if the registry gives none (then the tag is kept as is).

grandfathered.description: Every grandfathered tag, keyed in lower case (LANG-001 step 2).

redundant_preferred.description: Redundant tags (lower case) that have a replacement (sgn-br -> bzs), LANG-001 step 4.

iso639_2.description: Reading old fields (LANG-002): every ISO 639-2 code, B and T forms, plus four withdrawn codes -> canonical BCP 47 language subtag.

b.description: Bibliographic form — Matroska's old Language element (RFC 9559 §12).

t.description: Terminology form — MP4/MOV media header, and ID3.

iso639_2_for_language.description: Writing old fields (TRACK-070): BCP 47 language subtag -> its ISO 639-2 code in both forms. A language not listed has no ISO 639-2 code; write 'und'.

ranges.description: Inclusive [first, last] ranges, compared as plain ASCII.
